newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Oklahoma feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Oklahoma feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: USDA said trade was slow to moderate in the Panhandle area late Tuesday. Slaughter steers and heifers ended steady with last established trade.

Feedlots reported good inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 14,900 slaughter steers and 12,700 heifers; 50,700 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 20,200 formulated and 1,200 previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Steers - select and choice 2-3 1150-1250 lbs 63.00. Pen select, few choice 1150 lbs 62.50.
Heifers - select snd choice 2-3 1050-1150 lbs 63.00. Pen select, few choice 1050 lbs 62.00. Pen select and choice 2-3 1100 lbs including heiferettes 59.00.
Confirmed: 27,600 Week Ago: 48,400 Year Ago: None
Week to date: 50,700 Week Ago: 70,600 Year Ago: 19,200
